title: motion-strip: unaligned end_ms silently drops the final partial tick-window's cadence frames
detail: end_tick floors end_ms/tick_ms, so windows past the last whole tick are never walked: cadence times in the final partial window (verified: 2251ms missing for 'motion-strip motion 2200 2260 17' -> 3 frames; end 2300 -> 6) are silently unexported — the W5 missing-frame class.
recommended_fix: Ceil the walk bound (end_tick := u64((i64(end_ms) + tick_ms - 1) / tick_ms)) or drop end_tick and break only on win_start >= end_ms.

title: new motion_test.odin pins never execute in GitHub CI (render tests are local-gate-only)
evidence:
- name: Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)
        run: odin test core
--- ci-local.sh:56 ---
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test"
--- app/render/motion_test.odin:25 ---
// Run: odin test app/render   (the established render-test gate, gate 2).
detail: The workflow's sole odin-test step is 'odin test core'; 'odin test app/render' exists only in ci-local gate 2. A pushed regression to interp_continuous/packet_interp_pos passes GitHub CI green — the r1-B1/B2 protection is local-only.
recommended_fix: Add the app/render (and app/audio/harness) test invocations to the workflow's unit-test step, matching ci-local gate 2.

title: measure_packet_motion.py: trailing or non-numeric --xmax crashes with an uncaught traceback
detail: '--xmax' as the last argument (index+1 == len) or a non-numeric value raises an uncaught IndexError/ValueError traceback (verified: IndexError reproduced) instead of a usage error exit.
recommended_fix: Validate idx+1 < len(sys.argv) and wrap the int() parse; on failure print usage and exit 2.

title: measure_packet_motion.py: both-empty strip dirs pass the frame-name check and exit 0 vacuously
evidence:
b_names = [n for n, _ in before]
    a_names = [n for n, _ in after]
    if b_names != a_names:
...
    return 0
detail: Empty==empty name lists satisfy the W4 check; two empty (or all-non-PNG) dirs print 'BEFORE=0/0 AFTER=0/0 ... no moving frames' and exit 0 (verified) — a vacuous success with no measurement.
recommended_fix: Reject empty before/after tables with an error and exit 2 before comparing frame names.

title: doorstep-fan draw rule breaks interp_continuous's position-continuity premise at boarding/arrival (unguarded local dash)
detail: Boarding (frac crossing 0.02) and arrival transitions are identity-continuous, but the drawn prev/cur differ by the ~1-tile doorstep offset plus the per-tick advance — the guard lerps this unguarded discontinuity as a fast local dash.
recommended_fix: Add a distance guard that snaps when |cur - prev| exceeds plausible one-tick travel, or exclude the doorstep fan positions from the continuous kinds.
